name: brain
description: Persistent shared brain between AI assistant and operator. Not a RAG system — a living knowledge graph that heals itself, learns from conversations, and activates the right knowledge at the right moment. v9.4: S2 Healer (Haiku generates missing findability vectors from conversation context), S0 conversation API (traces + historic JSONL), edge_context vectors (nodes findable through their relationships), situation scoring wired (1085 dormant embeddings activated), group vector 100% coverage, ONNX thread-safety fix, recall eval framework (25 scenarios, 10 KPIs, 122 real-trace validation).
